title: Army garrison FFS / DFA food service and facility sanitation PWS technical exhibits: DFAC average headcount by meal period (weekday B/L/D/Midnight, weekend brunch/supper), closed DFAC, DFAC buildings repeated in the custodial facility list, current contract paragraph (PDF)

provenance.notes: Layout, terminology and wording follow real Army/Air Force food service PWS documents (weekday vs weekend & holiday meal periods, Warrior Restaurant naming, AFMIS headcount, DD Form 1544, TDA/TOE FFS vs DFA rule, maximum feeding capacity, historical meals served for information only). Every value is illustrative: Fort Branford, the solicitation and contract numbers, the incumbent (Sandhill Garrison Services, LLC), DFAC names, seats, headcounts, building numbers, square footage and dollar values are invented.

traps: Meals per day is not stated anywhere; it must be derived from TE 5-1 average headcount per meal period for a typical week: mealsPerDay = (sum of Monday–Friday meal-period averages × 5 + sum of Weekends & Holidays meal-period averages × 2) ÷ 7, rounded to the nearest whole meal. Bldg 4120: (410+905+520) = 1,835 × 5 = 9,175; (465+330) = 795 × 2 = 1,590; 10,765 ÷ 7 = 1,537.86 → 1,538. Bldg 7031: (285+640+390+115) = 1,430 × 5 = 7,150; (310+240) = 550 × 2 = 1,100; 8,250 ÷ 7 = 1,178.57 → 1,179. Bldg 9215: (140+315+188) = 643 × 5 = 3,215; (150+105) = 255 × 2 = 510; 3,725 ÷ 7 = 532.14 → 532. The formula ignores the weekday training/Federal holidays that run on the weekend schedule (paragraph 1.5 defines the averages per typical 5+2 week).
Taking only the weekday sum (1,835 / 1,430 / 643) or summing all six columns (2,630 / 1,980 / 898) as meals per day is wrong.

mealPeriods is the number of weekday meal periods served: 3 at Bldgs 4120 and 9215 (Late/Midnight shown as '—' / N/S), 4 at Bldg 7031 (Midnight meal Monday–Friday, Note 5/). Weekend brunch/supper (2 periods) is not the meal-period count. daysPerWeek is 7 for all three (TE 5-2 'Days Open' = 7).

Bldg 2240 Dragon Warrior Restaurant is 'CLOSED FOR RENOVATION THROUGH FY27 – NO WORKLOAD' in TE 5-1, closed in TE 5-2, carries FY24/FY25 history in TE 5-3, and is listed in TE 6-1 with 25,120 GSF but frequency N/A and no custodial area; it is excluded entirely (no facility, no dining profile).

Each in-scope DFAC appears twice (TE 5-1 food service workload and TE 6-1 custodial list) under the same building number; truth has ONE facility per building carrying both the TE 6-1 gross SF and the TE 5-1 dining profile. Emitting a second, SF-less 'dining' facility for 4120/7031/9215 is counted as an extra.

DFAC custodial service area (4,860 / 3,720 / 2,940 SF) is only restrooms, entries and admin (kitchen and dining room sanitation is under PWS Part 5); it is cleanableSqft, not grossSqft (28,460 / 22,740 / 16,380). Likewise TISA (31,600 GSF vs 4,280) and CIF (42,300 GSF vs 6,140).

Bldg 9215 Sentinel Warrior Restaurant is DFA only (Government 92G cooks, TOE units): still in scope with a dining profile, serviceStyle dining_facility_attendant (not representable in truth.json; Bldgs 4120 and 7031 are full_food_service).
Maximum Feeding Capacity per Meal (seats × 3: 1,800 / 1,350 / 900, total 4,050) sits next to the headcount columns and is not the workload; seating capacity (600 / 450 / 300) is not meals per day.
TE 5-1 TOTAL row (835 / 1,860 / 1,098 / 115 / 925 / 675) is a sum across DFACs, not a facility and not a daily headcount.

TE 5-3 historical meals served per fiscal year (e.g. 552,310 for 4120 in FY25; 9-month FY26 not annualized) are for information only; dividing them by 365 gives different numbers (1,513) than the TE 5-1 basis that paragraph 1.5 says to price.
TE 5-2 serving windows ('0930 – 1300', '2330 – 0100') are times, not headcounts or SF.

TE 6-1 Bldg 1475 Self-Service Supply Center is struck through and marked DELETED (vacated 30 JUN 2026) with 9,640 GSF still printed; excluded. The TOTAL – FACILITIES IN SCOPE (16) row (461,290 GSF / 299,950 SF) is not a facility.
Section 6-1.1 names facilities not included (Bldgs 5100/5104 health clinic, 4810 pool, 8101–8104 unaccompanied housing, Exchange); none are expected.
Frequency codes map to service levels: 7X/WK = daily_7, 5X/WK = daily_5, 3X/WK = 3x_week, 2X/WK = 2x_week.

Prior award is a narrative paragraph (1.4): incumbent Sandhill Garrison Services, LLC, Contract No. W9124J-21-C-0012, FFP, awarded 24 September 2021, total value $71,284,960 for a 12-month base plus four 12-month options (60 months), current option period annual value $14,962,415. The FAR 52.217-8 extension amount ($7,481,208, six months) and the separate field feeding IDIQ ceiling ($4,950,000, W9124J-24-D-0019) are distractors, not the prior award.
Contract years: new requirement is a 12-month base plus four 12-month options = 5; the potential six-month FAR 52.217-8 extension is not a contract year.

Mixed orientation: TE 5-1 and TE 5-2/5-3 are landscape pages; TE 6-1 is portrait and wraps long facility names (Bldg 115) to two or three lines. Running header and footer with solicitation number and page repeat on every page.
